國民生活時間調査 俸給生活者・工場勞務者編 1943

Kokumin seikatsu jikan chōsa: ippan chōsa hōkoku, hōkyū seikatsusha・kōjō rōmusha hen (National Time-Use Survey, General Survey Report: Salaried Employees and Factory Workers), 昭和18年
日本放送協會 (Japan Broadcasting Corporation, NHK), 東京, 1943

Every table is transcribed: the 16 national and 65 group time-of-day tables (by region, official/company employee, industry, size of works, living at home or in dormitories), the eight time-budget tables, the 65 listening-suitability tables and the small tables and workplace lists in the outline. The 16 listening-suitability charts (時刻別聽取適否參考圖) print no figures and are not reproduced; the prose is not transcribed. The scan holds two second shots of a spread (frames 116 and 138), which are not used. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye. Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the row add to 100, that reading is used and noted. Rows that do not add to 100 as printed (rounding, and some dropped or wrong digits in the type) are kept as printed and noted. 512 of about 335,000 cells could not be read and are marked [?].
